$comment: QADLC Claude Code settings. Hooks are advisory except the Stop hook, which enforces the plan-approval gate and checkbox discipline. Paths are relative to the project root; Claude Code runs them with bun. SessionStart runs through qadlc-preflight.sh so a missing bun reports itself once per session instead of surfacing as four bare 'command not found' errors with the plan gate silently failing open; --advisory keeps that report from becoming a harness error.
